method: Every expectation was written from the sources by reading them. No analysis tool was run on them, and no tool's detectors, source code or output were looked at. Line numbers were looked up by a scratch script that finds the line of a given piece of text and fails unless it occurs exactly once. A second scratch script ran main.js and both preloads in Node against a stand-in for the electron and electron-store modules (and wrapped fs and the global fetch), called every registered handler, every menu click and every exposed member, and printed every ipcMain registration, ipcMain.emit, webContents.send, webContents.ipc listener, new BrowserWindow with its merged webPreferences, request (net.fetch, fetch), store and file access, and the channel each member uses, with file:line; its output agreed with the expectations, on the plain sources, on the v2 tree and on the extracted minified build. The renderers were checked by reading and by a listing of their window.<api>.<member>(...), storage and fetch calls. LANGUAGE: main.js, preload.js and the modules in main/ and common/ are CommonJS in the shape tsc emits ("use strict", exports.X = void 0 headers, __importDefault, imported functions called as (0, mod_1.fn)(...), a string enum and a numeric enum compiled to IIFEs); main/ipc/shopping.js and preload-shopping.js are plain JavaScript (allowJs); the renderers are ES modules and renderer.js imports renderer/*.js. FILE ATTRIBUTION: facts are attributed to the source file a reader sees them in. Senders that go through the local helpers invoke / send of preload.js name preload.js. The shopping window's channels go through the generic members shopping.send / request / receive, which take the channel from the caller; they are attributed to renderer-shopping.js, where the channel is named, and places gives the ipcRenderer call in preload-shopping.js. A window setting names the file whose code calls new BrowserWindow (main/windows.js for mainWindow, main/app-window.js for the two AppWindows, main/pdf-export.js for printWindow), even where the value is written in another file (main/config.js, main/windows.js); lineFile then names the file of line. In the bundled and minified inputs the modules are bundled into their entry file; bundledFiles maps each module to that file, and line numbers then do not apply. Channel names come from the object IPC_CHANNELS (common/channels.js), the compiled enum MessageToWebApp (common/messages.js), a module constant (main/app-window.js MOUNTED) and literals; all are resolvable by evaluating the source, and no channel name is computed at run time. webPreferences lists the keys preload, contextIsolation, nodeIntegration, sandbox, one entry per window and key the code writes (also through Object.assign of a frozen config object, a conditional spread and a wrapper class); window names the variable that holds the window; count in an absent entry is one more than the number of windows that have that value, as in holdout4 to holdout7. STORAGE kinds: file (an app data file the code names), electron-store (a key of the electron-store instance, as a dot path), localStorage, sessionStorage. IPC payloads are not a scored class; the object literals sent over IPC are listed under ipcPayloadsUnscored for a reader.
